metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. FUJI PHOTO FILM motion picture film data sheet KB-913E (1999-05 (print code SK-99.05)), Fujifilm-Super-F-125-8532-35mm-Motion-Picture-Film.pdf, PDF page(s) 1, FUJICOLOR F-125 8532 / 8632: https://35mmdealer.de/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Fujifilm-Super-F-125-8532-35mm-Motion-Picture-Film.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): spectral sensitivity on a relative log scale (one log unit = the interval marked '1.0'), absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; base+fog and mid-scale dye densities read from the sheet, individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder (not printed); dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; FUJIFILM ETERNA-CP 3513/3514 is not in the repository); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives). Original data are property of the respective holders.
